name: The Silent Mars Colony
description: The first Mars settlement lost contact with Earth. Rebuild, investigate, and find the hidden laboratory.

story.title: The Silent Mars Colony
story.premise: The first Mars settlement suddenly lost communication with Earth.
story.background: Six astronauts built Aurora Base. On Sol 442 every transmission stopped mid-sentence.
story.centralConflict: Discover why the crew vanished while restoring the colony to survive.
story.playerRole: Investigator-engineer sent on the second landing window.
hiddenTruths: A lab hides beneath the western ridge

locations.name: Landing Zone
locations.description: Scorched descent pad and supply crates.

locations.name: Western Ridge
locations.description: Rocky overlook hiding a sealed entrance.

locations.name: Emergency Shelter
locations.description: Half-collapsed shelter with a pinned map.

objects.name: Habitat Control Panel

objects.name: Solar Controller
objects.description: Blinking controller asking for a sequence.

objects.description: Rover parked far from the garage, dust on the seats.

objects.name: Shelter Map

objects.description: A sealed hatch with a keypad.

objects.name: Survivor Ivan
objects.description: A gaunt figure in a patched suit, waving you closer.

objects.name: Flight Suit Locker

objects.name: Sky Chime
objects.description: A crystal humming high above the landing zone. Only reachable by flight.

objects.description: Nav marker for solar panel field.

objects.name: Water Extraction Station Beacon
objects.description: Nav marker for water extraction station.

characters.name: Dr. Ivan (recording)
dialogue: If you hear this, do not trust the official log.

resources.name: Flight Suit
resources.description: Pressurized suit with maneuvering thrusters. Enables flight.

objectives.description: Recover the flight suit (optional — enables flying)

missions.title: Find the Underground Laboratory
missions.description: Open the hidden entrance and discover the truth.

clues.title: Damaged Helmet
clues.text: The visor is cracked from the inside. Someone wanted out in a hurry.

clues.title: Helmet Recording
clues.text: "...bury it. Western ridge. The old crew spoke in mixed tongues — tattoos for the sun-born, toggles for the machine-born: VII · 11 · IV · 1001. Tell Earth we chose this."

clues.title: Broken Terminal Log
clues.text: SOL 441: Ivan ordered a full shutdown drill. SOL 442: [DATA MISSING].

clues.title: Wall Symbols
clues.text: Three glyphs: SUN, WAVE, EYE. They match the rover nav markings.

clues.title: Rover Coordinates
clues.text: Nav fragment: ridge approach -24, -8. The rover drove itself there.

clues.title: Maintenance Note
clues.text: Solar reset order, eldest first: IV → II → I → III. Never run the array backwards.

clues.title: Shelter Map
clues.text: X marks a vault under the shelter floor.

clues.title: Lab Access Code
clues.text: Keypad hint: the recording numbers + the symbol count.

clues.title: Song from Above
clues.text: The chime hums a lullaby Earth used to sing to its orbit stations. Someone carried music all the way here.

puzzles.title: Solar Activation Sequence
puzzles.description: Enter the 4-digit reset order. Hint: check the maintenance note.

hints.text: The maintenance note lists the order.

puzzles.title: Symbol Combination
puzzles.description: Enter the word formed by SUN-WAVE-EYE. (Hint: a hunter constellation)

hints.text: Think of the hunter in the night sky.

puzzles.title: Laboratory Access Code
puzzles.description: 4-digit keypad on the ridge hatch. The recording knows.

hints.text: Play the helmet recording again — then decode its mixed tongues.
Tattoos count like Romans, toggles count in binary. The decoder ring below reads both.

endings.title: The Truth Below
endings.description: The astronaut escaped into the lab to protect a discovery.

endings.title: Deliberate Silence
endings.description: Ivan shut the colony down himself.
